description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mampe, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521202
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
